platform: macOS native Makepad; desktop 1000x820 and phone-width 390x844

checks: desktop: all choices and Continue fit; selecting fills the address without adding unverified history
desktop: custom native registration, return to sign-in, and clearing details on server switch
desktop: browser and unavailable registration follow live capabilities, not password compatibility
desktop: selecting another server invalidates a pending discovery response
public servers: live SDK discovery reaches all three selected services and offers the expected action; no account submissions
phone: all choices and Continue fit; selecting fills the address without adding unverified history
phone: custom native registration, return to sign-in, and clearing details on server switch
phone: browser and unavailable registration follow live capabilities, not password compatibility
phone: selecting another server invalidates a pending discovery response
successful Matrix discovery persists a valid server
Continue works while history is expanded and avoids duplicates
focus shows recent-first destinations and empty input shows all
failed Matrix discovery does not enter history
typing filters; selection only fills; Continue rechecks and updates recency
Escape/outside click dismiss; repeat input click reopens
restart retains history without login credentials
filtering a scrolled long list returns to the first matching result

limitations: Phone-width captures use the native macOS renderer, not a physical Android or iOS device.
Public server checks stop at discovery and registration action selection. No real accounts are created. Browser callback and native credential submissions are tested against local Matrix fixtures.
Legacy email and CAPTCHA verification steps remain unsupported in the native form.
Palpo account-request approval and shared pending-action room integration are not part of this change.
